scenario.task:
I want to pay my current bill first, and then immediately set up autopay so I don't have to call back next month

User Guide: The user authenticates, pays their current balance, and then says, 'Now that that's paid, can we set up autopay so this happens automatically next month?' If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
